book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: Eibram mub go po Gera ane akt dat Sera i sisi blo em
Prom dem prapa spesil bigtri blo Mamre, Eibram i bin mub go libe dat ples biain ane em bin go saut po eria blo Negeb. Em bin stap melen dem ples blo Kades ane Sur wea taun blo Gera.
Wea dat taim, Eibram bin spik po dem pipol diskain, Sera oman blo em, i sisi blo em. So King Abimalek blo Gera bin singaut po Sera po kam po em ane Abimalek bin meke em po oman blo em.
Dat nait God i bin kam po Abimalek insaid lo drim ane bin spik po em, ‘Prapa tru! Yu go ded sun bikoz dat oman wea yu bin tekem, em i oman blo nada man.’
Bat Abimalek no bin slip wea Sera yet, so em bin aske God, ‘Yu go stil distroi mi ane pipol blo mi uda no bin meke rongting a?
Eibram emselp i bin spik po mi, “Sera em i sisi blo mi”, ane Sera emselp bin spik, “Wa, em bala blo mi.” Ai bin meke diswan wea gudat blo mi. Ai no bin meke eniting rong.’

Den God i bin kip tok po Abimalek insaid wea da drim blo em, ‘Wa, ai sabe yu bin meke disting wea gudat blo yu, ane wa, i bin mi uda bin stape yu prom meke nugudting gense mi. Daswai ai no bin laue yu po slip wea em.

Taim nau po teke da oman gobaigen po man blo em, bikoz man blo da oman i wan spesilmesizman ane em go prea po yu solong yu nogo ded. Bat ip yu no teke em gobaigen po man blo em, ai spik yu tru, bambai yu go ded, yu ane ol pipol blo yu.’
Wen i bin elimoning, Abimalek bin gedap ane bin singaut po ol edman blo em po kam. Ane em bin spik po dempla ebriting wanem i bin apen lo drim blo em. Dempla bin prapa nadakain prait.

Den Abimalek bin spik po teke Eibram kam po em ane em bin tok rapwei po Eibram diskain, ‘Wanem disting yu bin mekem po mipla? Ai no bin meke eni nugudting po yu. Bat tok blo yu bin meke mi ane pipol blo mi po meke wan prapa nugudting. Nobodi spostu meke ol nugud samting wiskain yu bin mekem po mi.
Watpo yu bin meke disting po?’
Eibram i bin ansa po King Abimalek, ‘Ai bin meke diswan bikoz ai bin tingk, ol pipol ya lo dis ples i no lisen ane pole God. Ai bin tingk dempla go kile mi solong ol ken teke oman blo mi.
Ane wa, em i prapa sisi blo mi. Mitu gad seim papa bat dipren mama, den apta ai bin maret em.
Ane wen God i bin spik mi po wagbaut go ane libe da aus blo papa blo mi biain, ai bin spik po oman blo mi po lugaut mi ane spik po ebri pipol demkain, ai bala blo em.’
Apta wen Eibram bin pinis dis tok, Abimalek bin teke plenti sip ane buluk, ane man ane oman sleib go gibem po Eibram ane wantaim i bin teke Sera gobaigen po Eibram.
Den Abimalek bin spik po Eibram, ‘Wa! Luk ebriwea lo dis ples ya wea ai bos. Yu ken stap eniwea wea yu wandem.’
Den Abimalek bin spik po Sera, ‘Tru gar. Ai gibe bala blo yu 1,000 pis blo silba. Diswan i po soe ebri pipol blo yu, yu no bin meke eniting rong. Ai no bleime yu.’

Da AntapGod i bin prapa stape ebri oman uda stap wea aus blo Abimalek bikoz em i bin teke Sera, oman blo Eibram. Den Eibram i prea nau po God, ane God bin wantaim gibe Abimalek baik da strong po meke pikinini ane wantaim meke oman blo em ane ol oman sleib kamgud solong dempla ken bone beibi.
